title: Slash rotating quote
description: One large centred serif quote at a time (52px on desktop, part of it in italic) with a small portrait, name and company under it. Quotes take turns on a loop, fading in with a 16px rise and sinking out, while a row of dots stretches the active one into a short bar.
notes: CSS only (keyframes written per instance for the quote count); reduced motion shows the first quote
